blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: India's 22 scheduled languages are spoken by over a billion people in conversations that mix languages, often within one turn, overlap freely, and take place over telephones, in meetings, and in media. Knowing who spoke when, the task of speaker diarization, is essential to speech applications for such conversation: voice agents conversing with several people at once, speaker attributed transcription of meetings and calls, contact center analytics, and media monitoring. We present a systematic study of speaker diarization across all 22 languages on IndicDiarBench and introduce Anuvani-Diarization, which adapts a self-supervised end-to-end segmentation model to Indian conversation with uncertainty aware silver supervision. Evaluated zero shot alongside nine recent diarization systems, it reaches a duration weighted diarization error rate (DER) of 16.78% on all 1,164 recordings, the lowest of all systems we ran and second only to the best published result (16.0%), and leads the three strongest rivals in 14 of 22 languages. It matches its parent on six international benchmarks. We also show that the benchmark's utterance level annotation convention is a hidden variable worth 1.9 to 4.1 DER points, depending on the system, and that a convention learned from other Indian transcriptions does not transfer.
blocks.zh: 印度的22种预定语言有超过10亿人在对话中讲,这些对话将语言混为一谈,往往在一个回合之内,自由重叠,通过电话、会议和媒体进行。 知何人何时发言,即演讲者数字化的任务,对于这种对话的语音应用至关重要:语音代理人一次与几个人交谈,演讲者对会议和电话的抄录、联系中心分析和媒体监测。 我们在IndicDiar Bench上对所有22种语言的扬声器diarization进行了系统研究,并引入了Anuvani-diarization,它将一个自我监督的端对端分化模型适用于印度对话,同时具有不确定性的银色监督。 在所有1,164个录音中, 它达到了16.78%的长度加权比对误差率, 是我们运行的所有系统中最低的, 它在六个国际基准上与母体相匹配。 我们还表明,根据系统的不同,基准的语音级别注释公约是一个隐藏的变量,价值为1.9至4.1 DER点,从其他印度语抄录中吸取的公约不会转移。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Conversation in India is multilingual by default. The Constitution recognizes 22 languages in its Eighth Schedule ( Ministry of Home Affairs, 2017 ) , the 2011 Census recorded 19,569 raw mother tongue returns and found that 96.71% of the population has a scheduled language as its mother tongue ( Registrar General of India, 2018 ) , and roughly a quarter of the population reports speaking a second language ( Sarma, 2025 ) . Speakers move between languages within a single turn ( Gumperz, 1982 ; Bali et al., 2014 ) , interject, and overlap, and the same conversation may be held over a telephone, a video call or around a table. Every downstream technology that attributes words to people, from meeting transcription to broadcast monitoring and call analytics, first needs to answer the fundamental question of who spoke when.
blocks.zh: 在印度的对话默认是多语种的. 《宪法》第8个表(内政部,2017年)承认22种语言,2011年人口普查记录了19,569个原始母语的返回,发现96.71%的人口以预定语言为母语(印度总注册官,2018年),大约四分之一的人口报告使用第二种语言(Sarma,2025年)。 发言者在一个回合内在语言之间移动(Gumperz,1982年;Bali等,2014年),插话和重叠,同一对话可以通过电话、视频电话或桌旁进行。 每一个将文字归属于人的下游技术,从会话抄录到广播监控和呼叫分析,首先需要回答谁何时说话的基本问题.

blocks.en: Until recently there was no benchmark that could measure this capability across India’s languages. The DISPLACE challenges introduced diarization of code mixed Indian conversation only for a handful of languages ( Baghel et al., 2023 ; Kalluri et al., 2024 ) , and IndicDiarBench ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) now provides 108 hours of human corrected, speaker attributed conversation in all 22 scheduled languages, recorded as near field meetings, far field meetings and in-the-wild video. Its first results came from services that transcribe and diarize jointly, the strongest at a diarization error rate (DER) of 16.0%; dedicated diarization systems, which most research and deployment build on, were not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 直到最近,还没有一个基准可以衡量印度各种语言的这种能力。 DISPLACE的挑战引入了只针对少数语言(Baghel等人,2023年;Kalluri等人,2024年;IndicDiar Bench (Mehendale等人,2026年))的印度混合对话代码的分化,现在提供了108小时的人类更正时间,演讲者将所有22种排定语言的交谈归结为近现场会议、远现场会议和闪烁的视频。 其第一批成果来自联合转换和分化的服务,其中最强的是16.0%的分化误差率;大多数研究和部署所依赖的专用分化系统没有得到评价。

blocks.en: We ask how the strongest diarization systems perform on Indian conversation when measured blind under one protocol, what, beyond acoustics, determines their errors, and what it would take to lead across the 22 languages. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们问,最强的对等化系统如何对印度对话发挥作用,如果在一个协议下被测得盲目,除了声学之外,还有什么能决定其错误,以及在22种语言中起什么作用。 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • A blind evaluation of nine diarization systems on all 1,164 IndicDiarBench recordings, with two independent scorer implementations, bootstrap intervals over source recordings and byte identical sharded inference (§ 4 ). • Annotation convention as a hidden variable. The references segment speech the way transcribers do, into utterances; diarizers segment it at pauses. The gap moves every system by 1.9–4.1 pp of DER and the same correction is harmful on word aligned benchmarks, so convention must be an explicit property of a diarizer’s output; a convention learned from Indian telephone transcriptions does not transfer to the benchmark (§ 5 ). • Anuvani-Diarization , an Indic adaptation of a self-supervised end-to-end segmentation model with uncertainty aware silver supervision from channel separated telephone calls (§ 6 ). Evaluated zero shot, with no part fitted or selected on the benchmark, it reaches 16.78% duration weighted DER, the lowest of all systems we ran (Figure 2 ), and leads the three strongest other systems in 14 of the 22 languages (Table 1 ). • Generality : the adapted network matches its parent on six international benchmarks (§ 7.4 ).
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 对所有1,164张IndicDiar Bench录音的9个对等化系统进行盲目评估,采用两个独立的记分器,在源录音和同字节相同的硬化推论上设置间隔(第4节)。 • 作为隐藏变量的说明公约。 引用段的语法是: 转写器的语法, 变成发音; 分解器在暂停时将其分出。 差距使每个系统都比DER的1.9–4.1pp移动,同样的修正对字面一致的基准是有害的,因此,惯例必须是一个对称器产出的明确属性;从印度电话抄写中吸取的惯例不会转移到基准(§5). • Anuvani-Diarization,是对自我监督的端到端分接模式的一次特别修改,该模式对频道分接的电话进行银色监督具有不确定性(第6节)。 评价为零射出,没有在基准上安装或选择任何部件,它达到了16.78%的加权DER,是我们运行的所有系统中最低的(图2),并领导了22种语言中14种最强大的其他三个系统(表1)。 • 普遍性:经调整的网络在六个国际基准上与其母网相匹配(第7.4节)。

blocks.en: 2 Diarizing India: A Linguistic Perspective
blocks.zh: 2 印度的分化:语言视角

blocks.en: Diarization is usually treated as a language independent task: a speaker’s voice is assumed to be the same regardless of the language they speak. India tests this assumption in four ways.
blocks.zh: 分化通常被视为一种语言上独立的任务:演讲者的声音被假定是相同的,不管他们说哪种语言. 印度从四个方面检验了这一假设。

blocks.en: The 22 scheduled languages range from Hindi, the mother tongue of 528.3 million people (43.63% of the population), to Sanskrit, returned as a mother tongue by 24,821 people ( Registrar General of India, 2018 ) . Eleven of them have more than thirty million mother tongue speakers each. The country’s Greenberg diversity index is 0.930: two randomly chosen residents would almost always have different native languages ( Sarma, 2025 ) . IndicDiarBench mirrors this distribution only partly. Eight of its languages (Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil and Telugu) each contribute about four hours of near field meetings and appear in far field and in-the-wild recordings, while the fourteen others contribute about 1.5 hours of near field meetings each, and twelve of them appear in no other condition ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) . A diarizer for India must therefore work well on languages for which almost no conversational training data exists.
blocks.zh: 22种预定语言从5.283亿人的母语印地语(占人口的43.63%)到梵语,有24,821人作为母语返回(2018年印度总注册). 其中11个各有3 000多万母语使用者。 全国的格林伯格多样性指数为0.930:两个随机选择的居民几乎总会有不同的母语(Sarma,2025年). IndicDiar Bench只部分地反映了这种分布. 其八种语言(本加利语、古吉拉特语、印地语、坎纳达语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语和泰卢古语)各贡献大约4小时的近现场会议,并出现在远实地和现场的录音中,其他十四种则贡献大约1.5小时的近实地会议,其中十二种没有其他条件出现(Mehendale等,2026年)。 因此,对印度而言,在几乎没有对话培训数据的语言方面,必须很好地发挥作用。

blocks.en: The scheduled languages belong to four families: fifteen are Indo-Aryan, four Dravidian (Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu), two Tibeto-Burman (Bodo, Manipuri) and one Austroasiatic (Santali); they are written in more than ten scripts (Table 1 ). Centuries of contact have made South Asia a linguistic area in which unrelated languages share structural and phonetic features ( Emeneau, 1956 ; Masica, 1976 ) , most audibly the contrast between retroflex and dental consonants and, in Indo-Aryan, a four way laryngeal contrast among stops ( Ladefoged and Maddieson, 1996 ) . Some features are local: Punjabi has lexical tone ( Hussain et al., 2020 ) , and Manipuri (Meitei) contrasts high and low lexical tones ( Chelliah, 1997 ) . Pitch and timing, two cues that speaker embedding models exploit, thus carry linguistic as well as personal information. Even the English spoken in these conversations is shaped by the speaker’s first language ( Kachru, 1983 ; Sirsa and Redford, 2013 ) . For speaker diarization, this means that a speaker model trained mostly on English must separate who is speaking from which language, and which variety of English, is being spoken.
blocks.zh: 预定语言分属4个家族:15个为印阿兰语,4个为德拉维德语(干纳达语,马来亚拉姆语,泰米尔语,泰卢古语),2个为西藏-布尔曼语(博多语,马尼普里语)和1个为澳语(桑塔利语);它们用十多个文字书写(表1). 百年接触使南亚成为一个语言领域,不相关的语言在其中具有结构和口语特征(Emeneau,1956年;Masica,1976年),最明显的是逆行和牙科对齐之间的对比,在印度-雅利安,各站之间有四条喉咙对称(Ladevoged和Madddieson,1996年)。 一些特征是本地的: 旁遮普语有语法语调(Hussain等,2020年),而马尼普里语(Meitei)则与高低语法音调形成对比(Chelliah,1997年). 夹克和计时,两道插入演讲者模型的提示,从而传递语言和个人信息。 甚至连这些谈话中讲的英语也由演讲者的第一语言所塑造(Kachru,1983;Sirsa and Redford,2013. 就发言者的对等化而言,这意味着主要受过英语培训的发言者模型必须把讲哪一种语言和讲哪一种英语区分开来。

blocks.en: Multilingual speakers switch languages within a given conversation for discourse purposes ( Gumperz, 1982 ) , and Hindi English mixing reaches into almost every register ( Bali et al., 2014 ; Sitaram et al., 2019 ) . IndicDiarBench’s annotators transcribe this mixing explicitly, and its authors describe the corpus as rich in “English code mixing, dialectal variation, and frequent speaker overlap” ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) . Turn taking is universal in its basic organization but culturally variable when it comes to timing ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Stivers et al., 2009 ; Levinson, 2016 ) : transitions that occur between speakers are short, and a substantial share of them have overlaps rather than gaps ( Heldner and Edlund, 2010 ) . In IndicDiarBench this share of overlapped speech varies from 6.1% (Punjabi) to 24.7% (Maithili) across languages; in-the-wild video has the least overlap (6.5%), and near field meetings, whose participants were given debate topics, have the most overlap ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 多语种的演讲者将特定对话中的语言切换为对话目的(Gumperz,1982年),印地语混合几乎可以进入每个登记册(Bali等,2014年;Sitaram等,2019年)。 IndicDiar Bench的注释者明确记录了这种混杂现象,其作者称,这种混杂现象含有丰富的 " 英文编码相混、方言相变和经常的扬声器相重叠 " (Mehendale等人,2026年)。 转接在其基本组织上是普遍的,但在时机方面则具有文化上的可变性(Sacks等人,1974年;Stivers等人,2009年;Levinson,2016年) :发言者之间的过渡时间很短,其中很大一部分有重叠而不是空白(Holdner和Edlund,2010年)。 在IndicDiar Bench语中,不同语言之间重叠的演讲比例从6.1%(朋贾比语)到24.7%(Maithili语)不等;无线视频的重叠程度最低(6.5%),而与会者被赋予辩论议题的近地点会议重叠程度最高(Mehendale等,2026年)。

blocks.en: Most importantly for this paper, a diarization reference embodies a theory of what a turn is. Word aligned references, typically derived from forced alignment, place segment boundaries at acoustic pauses. IndicDiarBench’s references are built by professional transcribers who correct speaker attributed, segment level transcriptions ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) ; their unit is the transcribed utterance, and short pauses which are within an utterance are not considered segment boundaries. Section 5 shows that this linguistic choice, rather than any acoustic property, is one of the largest single factors in diarization error on the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 最重要的是,对于本文来说,一种分化的提法体现了一个什么是转折的理论. 单词对齐的引用,一般由强制对齐而来,在相声暂停时将段边界放置. IndicDiar Bench的参考文献是由专业的转写者编写的,这些转写者纠正了所归属的扬声器,分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分层分 第5节显示,这种语言选择,而不是任何声学属性,是基准分化误差的最大单一因素之一.

blocks.en: 3 Related Work
blocks.zh: 3 相关工作

blocks.en: Modular diarization systems detect speech, embed short segments and cluster the embeddings, with Bayesian HMM clustering of x-vectors (VBx) as a strong back end ( Landini et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2022 ) . End-to-end neural diarization (EEND) predicts speaker activities jointly and processes overlap natively ( Fujita et al., 2019 ) ; EEND with vector clustering (EEND-VC) combines local end-to-end segmentation with global clustering, so that recordings of any length and speaker count can be processed effectively ( Kinoshita et al., 2021 ) . The powerset formulation casts local segmentation as single label classification over subsets of active speakers ( Plaquet and Bredin, 2023 ) and underlies pyannote ( Bredin, 2023 ; pyannote, 2025 ) ; DiariZen replaces its front end with a structurally pruned WavLM ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Han et al., 2025a ; Han et al., 2025b ) and a Conformer ( Gulati et al., 2020 ) . NVIDIA Sortformer models are trained explicitly with arrival-time-ordered speaker supervision ( Park et al., 2024 ; Medennikov et al., 2025 ) , the approach of NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 模块分化系统检测出语音,嵌入了短段并集群了嵌入物,由Bayesian HMM将x-vectors(VBx)集群为强后端(Landini等,2022;Park等,2022.). 端到端神经分化(EEND)预言会共同进行扬声器活动,处理方式在本土重叠(Fujita等,2019年;EEND与矢量分化(EEND-VC)将局部端到端分化与全球分化相结合,使任何长度和扬声器计数的录音都能被有效处理(Kinoshita等,2021年). Powerset配方将局部分化作为单一标签分类,将其置于活性扬声器子集之上(Plaquet and Bredin, 2023)并基于活性发声器(Bredin, 2023; pyannote, 2025); Diari). 禅取而代之的是结构化的瓦夫LM(Chen等,2022;Han等,2025a; Han等人,2025年b)和A Conformer (Gulati等,2020年.). 纳米比亚 分门别类的模型都经过了明确培训,并配备了抵达时按顺序排列的扬声器监督(Park等人,2024年;Medennikov等人,2025年;NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization的方法(NVIDIA,2026年)。

blocks.en: DER is sensitive to how references are made. Benchmarks differ in forgiveness collars and in whether overlap is scored; DIHARD established the strict setting of no collar with overlap scored ( Ryant et al., 2021 ) , and the underlying scoring tools differ in how they treat overlapping same speaker references ( Bredin, 2017 ; Ryant, 2018 ) . Most closely related to our analysis, Horiguchi et al. (2026b) decompose DER into a pause attributable component and a core component, and recent work trains models toward tight segment boundaries ( Horiguchi et al., 2026a ) . We complement this line by measuring the convention of a multilingual benchmark directly, by showing that its effect is large and system wide, and by testing whether a convention learned from other transcriptions transfers to it.
blocks.zh: 对外关系司对如何提供参考资料很敏感。 宽恕领和重叠是否得分的基准不同;DIHARD确立了严格的无重叠领设置(Ryant等,2021年),而基本的评分工具在如何处理重叠的同名演讲者参考(Bredin,2017;Ryant,2018年)上也存在差异. 与我们的分析最密切相关的是,Horiguchi等人(2026年b)将DER分解成一个暂停可归结的组件和一个核心组件,以及最近的工作列车模型走向紧凑的分界线(Horiguchi等人,2026年a). 我们通过直接衡量多语种基准的公约、表明其影响是庞大的和全系统的以及测试一项公约是否从其他转录中吸取教训来补充这一条线。

blocks.en: Large data collection efforts have produced corpora and benchmarks for Indian languages, including IndicVoices ( Javed et al., 2024 ) , Kathbath and IndicSUPERB ( Javed et al., 2023 ) , IndicWav2Vec ( Javed et al., 2021 ) , SPRING-INX ( Nithya R et al., 2023 ) and the MahaDhwani pre-training corpus ( Bhogale et al., 2025 ) ; code switched recognition has its own challenge series ( Diwan et al., 2021 ) . For diarization, DISPLACE 2023 provided 32 hours of code mixed conversation and DISPLACE 2024 158 hours, 38 of them labeled, in five Indian languages ( Baghel et al., 2023 ; Kalluri et al., 2024 ; Mehendale et al., 2026 ) ; IndicDiarBench is the first benchmark to cover all 22 scheduled languages ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大量的数据收集工作为印度语言制定了公司和基准,包括IndicVoices(Javed等,2024年),Kathbath和IndicSUPERB(Javed等,2023年),IndicWav2Vec(Javed等,2021年),SPRING-INX(Nithya R等,2023年)和MahaDhwani预训书(Bhogale等,2025年);代码转换识别有其自身的挑战系列(Diwan等,2021年)。 对于分化,DISPLACE 2023提供了32小时的代码混合对话,DISPLACE 2024 158小时,其中38小时被标注为以5种印度语言(Baghel等,2023;Kalluri等,2024;Mehendale等,2026;IndicDiar Bench是第一个覆盖所有22种预定语言的基准(Mehendale等,2026).

blocks.en: A related concurrent study evaluates spoken language identification across Indian languages, with emphasis on short-input robustness, calibration and language confusion ( Anonymous, 2026 ) . Its prediction target is the language of an audio segment. In contrast, this work predicts speaker activity over time and studies diarization error and annotation conventions. The two studies share their authors and build on publicly released Indian speech corpora; the public SPRING-INX corpus appears in both (as adaptation data here, as a held-out evaluation set there). Their pretrained backbones, benchmarks and experiments are otherwise distinct. The contributions and evaluations concern different speech-processing tasks.
blocks.zh: 一项相关的同时研究评估了印度各种语言的口语识别,重点是短投入强性、校准和语言混乱(匿名,2026年)。 它的预测目标是一个音频段的语言. 相比之下,这项工作预测了一段时间的演讲者活动并研究了分化错误和注释惯例。 这两项研究分享了他们的作者,并以公开发表的印度演讲体为基础;公开的SPRING-INX教义出现在这两部著作中(此处的适应数据是其中的搁置评价)。 它们的先入为主的骨干、基准和实验是不同的。 贡献和评价涉及不同的语音处理任务。

blocks.en: 4 Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: IndicDiarBench contains 1,164 recordings (107.7 hours) with 2 to 9 speakers each: near field meetings recorded over an online platform with one close microphone per participant (about 53 hours, all 22 languages), far field meetings (27 hours, eight languages) and in-the-wild YouTube conversations (28 hours, ten languages). These meetings involve 485 speakers from 189 districts; references come from a five stage human pipeline ( Mehendale et al., 2026 ) . We use the Hugging Face release at revision 92877ba.
blocks.zh: IndicDiar Bench载有1 164个录音(107.7小时),每集有2至9名发言者:在在线平台上录制的近现场会议,每个参与者有一个近距离麦克风(约53小时,全部22种语言),远地的现场会议(27小时,8种语言)和Wind YouTube对话(28小时,10种语言)。 这些会议有来自189个区的485名发言者参加;参考材料来自五个阶段的人类管道(Mehendale等,2026年)。 我们使用92877ba版的"拥抱相"发布.

We score with NIST md-eval semantics (our scorer is identical to dscore ( Ryant, 2018 ) on every system and set we checked); the scorer merges the small number of overlapping same speaker reference segments in the benchmark. We report both pooled (micro) DER and the duration weighted average used by the benchmark paper. Confidence intervals come from 5,000 bootstrap resamples of the 590 source recordings (seed 3407).

blocks.en: We ran nine diarization systems on the same single channel audio with each project’s recommended configuration: pyannoteAI Precision-2 through its commercial API ( pyannoteAI, 2026 ) , DiariZen WavLM-Large s80 md-v2 ( Han et al., 2025a ) , NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization ( NVIDIA, 2026 ) , pyannote speaker-diarization-community-1 ( pyannote, 2025 ) , NVIDIA Streaming Sortformer 4-speaker v2.1 and NVIDIA Sortformer 4-speaker v1 ( Park et al., 2024 ; Medennikov et al., 2025 ) , DiCoW v3.3 ( BUT Speech@FIT, 2025 ) , the 3D-Speaker pipeline ( Chen et al., 2024 ) and MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize ( MOSI.AI et al., 2026 ) . All outputs were scored together. For the systems that we ran on several GPUs, a single GPU replay of all 1,164 recordings reproduced the sharded outputs byte for byte.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一个频道音频上运行了9个对称系统,每个项目推荐的配置: PyannoteAI Precise-2通过其商业API(pyannoteAI,2026年),DiariZen WavLM-Large s80 md-v2(Han等,2025年a),NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization(NVIDIA,2026),泛音扬子扬子扬子-二相通-社区-1(pyannote,2025),NVIDIA Streaming Sortformer 4-Sortformer v2.1和NVIDIA Sortfortformer 4-sormer v1(Park等,2024;Medennikov等,2025),DiCoW v3.3(But Speech@FIT,2025),3D-Speaker管道(Chen等,2024)和MOSS-TRANLIS-Diarize(MO. AI等, 2026 (英语). 所有产出都得到评分。 对于我们运行在数个GPU上的系统,一个所有1,164个录音的单个GPU重放,复制了被压缩的输出字节作为字节.

blocks.en: Nothing in our system, Anuvani-Diarization, was trained, tuned or selected on IndicDiarBench. The segmentation network was adapted on other recordings (§ 6 ), audio fingerprint screening found no audio shared with the benchmark, the recipe and checkpoint were fixed on an internal panel of non-benchmark recordings, and its clustering uses the parent model’s default settings. The system was frozen before it was first scored on the benchmark, although earlier versions of it had been scored there. The competitor systems were run off the shelf, so every system we report was evaluated zero shot.
blocks.zh: 我们系统中没有任何东西,即Anuvani-Diarization,在IndicDiar Bench上受过训练、调制或被选中。 分块网络是根据其他录音(§ 6)改编而成的,音频指纹筛选没有发现与基准共享的音频,食谱和检查点被固定在一个非分块记录的内部面板上,其分组使用母模型的默认设置. 该系统在首次被打入基准之前就被冻结了,尽管早先的版本已经在那里打入了分数. 竞争者系统被从架子上冲出,所以我们报告的每个系统都被评价为零镜头.

blocks.en: 5 Annotation Convention as a Hidden Variable
blocks.zh: 5 《作为隐藏变量的说明公约》

blocks.en: Figure 3: The benchmark’s references segment speech into utterances; diarizers segment it at pauses. Left: share of same speaker gaps shorter than 0.5 s on all 1,164 recordings. Right: pooled DER as same speaker gaps shorter than g g are bridged ( y y -axis from 12.5%); dashed: Anuvani-Diarization with a convention learned from Indian telephone transcripts, scored once (§ 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 图3:基准部分的语句参考语句;分音符在暂停时分出. 左:在同一发言者中,在所有1 164个录音中,有0.5秒以下的差距。 右:将DER集合起来,因为同声器的相差小于克(y-y-轴距为12.5%);破损:Anuvani-Diarization,从印度电话记录中学习到一个会话,得分一次(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (left) compares gaps between consecutive same speaker segments. In IndicDiarBench’s references only 7.7% of such gaps are shorter than half a second, and only 3.4% in the near field meetings. In the output of every diarizer in Figure 3 (left), the share is between 24.9% and 32.1%. The systems are not wrong about the acoustics: speakers tend to pause inside their turns. They disagree with the references about what counts as a segment, and every such pause inside a reference utterance is scored as missed speech.
blocks.zh: 图3(左)比较了连续各段发言者之间的差距。 IndicDiar Bench只提到7.7%的空档时间短于半秒,在接近实地会议时只有3.4%。 在图3(左)中每个对数器的输出中,该比例在24.9%至32.1%之间. 系统对声学没有错误:扬声器往往会在其转弯内被暂停. 他们不同意关于什么才算一个片段的引用,在引用的语句中,每一个这样的暂停都会被评为漏掉的语句.

blocks.en: Bridging same speaker gaps shorter than a threshold g g is a convention change that leaves the acoustic decisions untouched. Its effect is large and consistent (Figure 3 , right; Table 2 ). As a sensitivity analysis, with g g chosen on the benchmark itself (a measurement of the convention, not a system), DER falls by 1.90 pp for Anuvani-Diarization, 2.03 pp for pyannoteAI Precision-2, 2.91 pp for DiariZen md-v2 and 4.14 pp for NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization, the most finely segmenting system we measured, at thresholds of 0.8 to 1.0 s.
blocks.zh: 缩小同一位发言者的相距短于一个阈值g,是一种公约变化,使声学决定不受影响。 其效果是大而一致的(图3,对;表2.)。 作为敏感度分析,在基准本身(对公约的衡量,而不是一个系统)选择克后,DER以0.8至1.0 s的阈值,在0.8至1.0 s的临界值上,DER下降1.90 pp,pyannoteAI Precisioni-2,2.91 pp,DiariZen md-v2和4.14 pp,NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Diarization是最精细的分解系统。

Bottom: on word aligned references, bridging at g = 1.0 g=1.0 s raises DER.

blocks.en: Applied to benchmarks whose references are word aligned, the same bridging raises DER, by 0.68 to 6.01 pp on VoxConverse, NOTSOFAR-1 and MagicData-RAMC (Table 2 , bottom). There is therefore no convention free output: the best segmentation depends on whose notion of a turn is being scored. Utterance level references suit speaker attributed transcription and word aligned references acoustic analysis, and neither is wrong. We draw three consequences: benchmarks should document their segmentation conventions as precisely as their collar and overlap rules; systems should be compared only under matched output conventions; and a diarizer should expose its convention as an explicit, documented mode rather than silently adopting one.
blocks.zh: 同一桥接将DER提高0.68至6.01页的VoxConverse、NOTSOFAR-1和MagicData-RAMC(表2,下方)的参照基准。 因此,没有公约免费产出:最好的分割取决于谁的转弯概念被打中。 Utterance级的参考语服演讲者将转录和单词对齐的参考语声分析归结,两者都是错误的. 我们得出了三种结果:基准应准确记录其分类公约,如同其项圈和重叠规则一样;只应在相应的产出公约下对制度加以比较;而分化器应将其公约暴露为一种明确、有文件记录的模式,而不是默默地采用的模式。

blocks.en: 5.1 Learning an annotation convention
blocks.zh: 5.1 学习注释公约

blocks.en: Can the convention be learned without the benchmark’s labels? We fitted a convention decoder on human transcriptions of 302 SPRING-INX telephone calls, which, like the benchmark’s references, are speaker attributed utterance spans; chose every setting on 35 held out calls under a protocol fixed in advance; and scored the frozen system once on all 1,164 recordings. DER rose from 17.11% to 22.74% (Table 4 ): missed speech fell from 8.91% to 2.89%, but false alarm rose from 3.55% to 15.29%. On the telephone transcripts, bridging kept helping up to the largest gap we allowed (1.5 s): their transcribers keep an utterance open across longer pauses than the benchmark’s annotators do. Two corpora that both segment speech into transcribed utterances thus still disagree about where an utterance ends, so a diarizer can match a benchmark’s convention only from references produced the same way.
blocks.zh: 能否在没有基准标签的情况下学习公约? 我们安装了302 SPRING-INX 电话的人类录音机, 与基准的参考文献一样, DER从17.11%上升到22.74%(表4):失语率从8.91%下降到2.89%,但假警报从3.55%上升到15.29%。 在电话记录簿上,连接不断帮助达到我们所允许的最大差距(1.5 s):他们的收发器比基准的注解者更长时间的暂停。 因此,两部分的语音都转录到语句上,对于语句到哪里结束仍有分歧,因此,一个分音器只能通过同样的方式来匹配基准惯例。

blocks.en: A protocol fixing every candidate and decision rule was committed before any measurement, and a filesystem guard refused every IndicDiarBench file to the selection code. For this experiment only, clustering was chosen on 146 recordings of NOTSOFAR-1, VoxConverse, SPRING-INX, AMI, AISHELL-4 and AliMeeting from 21 VBx configurations, with and without a cannot-link repair that splits clusters whose strongly supported local speakers share a window; the repair at threshold 0.65 and F a = 0.06 F_{a}=0.06 won (mean pooled DER 12.26% against 12.51% for the default).
blocks.zh: 在进行任何测量之前,都执行了一项确定每个候选人和决定规则的协议,一个文件系统守卫拒绝选择代码的每个IndicDiar Bench文件。 仅在这项实验中,从21个VBx配置中选取了146个NOTSOFAR-1、VoxConverse、SPRING-INX、AMI、ASHELL-4和Ali Meeting的录音片,其中包含和没有无法连接的修复,这些修复将强烈支持本地发言者的集群共享一个窗口;在阈值0.65和F a=0.06 F_{a}=0.06的修复(默认情况下,平均集合DER为12.26%,12.51%)。

blocks.en: References for the convention were the human transcript spans of each SPRING-INX call’s two channels. The bridging gap was chosen on 35 held out calls from g ∈ { 0 , 0.25 , … , 1.5 } g\in\{0,0.25,\dots,1.5\} s (best: 1.5 s). The decoder, gradient boosted regression trees ( Ke et al., 2017 ; Pedregosa et al., 2011 ) with 400 iterations, learning rate 0.05, 31 leaves and at least 200 samples per leaf, predicts for every same speaker gap and every segment shorter than 3 s the change in error time that bridging the gap or dropping the segment would cause, from the local geometry, the recording and the network’s own evidence.
blocks.zh: 公约的参考文献是每个SPRING-INX电话的两个频道的人文记录。 在35个电话中选择了连接的空隙。 解码器、梯度增强回归树(Ke等人,2017年;Pedregosa等人,2011年),每片叶有400个迭代、学习速率0.05、31叶和至少200个样本,预测每个同声孔和每段短于3分之3的误差时间变化会从局部几何、记录和网络本身的证据中产生。

blocks.en: Fitted on the 302 training calls, it beat blanket bridging on the 35 held out calls (duration weighted DER 30.02% against 32.11%, paired 95% CI entirely below zero) and was adopted. The frozen system was scored once on IndicDiarBench: 22.74% pooled and 22.43% duration weighted DER.
blocks.zh: 根据302个培训电话,它将35个电话的毛毯接通(加权DER为30.02%,32.11%,95%CI完全低于零)并被采纳。 在IndicDiar Bench上,冻结系统一度得分:22.74%的积分和22.43%的加权DER。

blocks.en: 6 Anuvani-Diarization
blocks.zh: 6. 阿努瓦尼-迪阿里化

blocks.en: Figure 4: Anuvani-Diarization. The Indic-adapted segmentation network combines a pruned WavLM-Large encoder with four Conformer blocks (blue) and predicts 16 powerset classes every 20 ms. The inset opens one Conformer block. Overlap-free speaker embeddings and VBx clustering link local speakers across windows; chips summarise the adaptation recipe.
blocks.zh: 图4:阿努瓦尼-迪亚化。 Indic-adapted分块网络将一个被pruned WavLM-Large编码器与四个Conformer区块(蓝色)合并,并预测每20 ms有16个电源集分. 套接字打开一个Conformer区块. 无重叠扬声器嵌入和VBx集群将本地扬声器连接到窗口之间;芯片概括了适应方法.

blocks.en: Anuvani-Diarization follows the EEND-VC design (Figure 4 ). A segmentation network processes 16 s windows with a 1.6 s hop and predicts, for every 20 ms frame, one of 16 powerset classes over four local speakers. Overlap free frames of each local speaker are embedded with a ResNet34 speaker model ( He et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , local speakers are linked across windows by VBx clustering with the parent model’s probabilistic linear discriminant analysis (PLDA) and default settings, and the frame level activities are aggregated into a recording level segmentation. Nothing after the network is tuned.
blocks.zh: Anuvani-Diarization遵循了EEND-VC的设计(图4.). 一个分块网络处理16 s 窗口,一个1.6 s hop,并预测,每20 ms 帧,一个16个电源集班,超过4个本地扬声器。 每个本地扬声器的重叠自由帧被嵌入到ResNet34的扬声器模型(He等,2016;Wang等,2023)中,由VBx集群连接到各窗口之间,与母模型的概率线性差异分析(PLDA)和默认设置相连接,帧级活动被汇总为记录级分解. 网络之后什么也没有调取。

blocks.en: We start from DiariZen WavLM-Large s80 md-v2, whose segmentation network combines a WavLM-Large encoder pruned to 80% sparsity with a Conformer head ( Han et al., 2025a ; Han et al., 2025b ) , and adapt it to Indian conversational speech.
blocks.zh: 我们从DiariZen WavLM-Large s80 md-v2开始,它们的分块网络将一个WavLM-Large编码器同一个前头连接到80%的螺旋(Han等人,2025a; Han et al., 2025b.),并适应印度对话演说.

blocks.en: The adaptation set contains 848 recordings (370.5 hours). Indian conversation comes from 302 two party telephone calls of SPRING-INX in eight languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil; 98.5 hours) ( Nithya R et al., 2023 ) . Multi-party meetings come from NOTSOFAR-1 (71 recordings, 7.3 hours) ( Vinnikov et al., 2024 ) , AMI (101, 59.9 hours) ( Carletta et al., 2005 ) , AISHELL-4 (173, 97.2 hours) ( Fu et al., 2021 ) and AliMeeting (201, 107.6 hours) ( Yu et al., 2022 ) . Each mini-batch draws 50% of its crops from the Indian calls with languages balanced, 25% from NOTSOFAR-1 and 25% from the other meetings. The 302 calls are 90 calls admitted first and 212 of 346 later candidates: before admission, every candidate was screened against every other recording by acoustic fingerprinting ( Lalinský, 2010 ) with waveform corroboration, the 134 candidates that matched another recording were held out, and no audio in the adaptation set is shared with the benchmark.

blocks.en: Each SPRING-INX call was recorded with one channel per speaker, which yields speaker labels without manual annotation, but channel evidence is imperfect: a quiet speaker, crosstalk or untranscribed speech can make a label wrong. Rather than trusting or discarding such labels, we mark every 10 ms cell as known or unknown. A cell is unknown if a positive label lacks energy support on its own channel, is more than 15 dB quieter than the other channel, contradicts a transcript interval, falls within 100 ms of a label or transcript boundary, or disagrees with an independent pretrained diarizer applied to each isolated channel. Unknown frames contribute no loss; quiet positives are masked rather than relabeled as silence. Of the 98.5 hours of call audio, 51.9 hours remain supervised.
blocks.zh: 每个SPRING-INX的通话都用每名演讲者一个频道录制,该频道在没有人工注释的情况下产生演讲者标签,但频道证据并不完善:安静的演讲者,交叉交谈或未加描述的演讲可以使标签出错. 我们不是相信或抛弃这种标签,而是将每10毫秒的单元格标为已知或未知。 如果一个正标签在自己的信道上缺乏能量支持,比另一个信道更安静地15分贝以上,与一个记录片间隔相矛盾,在标签或记录片边界100ms以内,或者不同意每个被隔离的信道都应用一个独立的预先训练的定子,则一个单元格是未知的. 未知框架不会造成损失;静态正态被掩盖,而不是被重新贴上沉默的标签. 在98.5小时的通话音频中,51.9小时仍然受到监督。

blocks.en: We train all parameters jointly for 3,000 updates of 96 sixteen second crops each (288,000 crops) with AdamW ( β = ( 0.9 , 0.98 ) \beta=(0.9,0.98) , weight decay 0.01), learning rates of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} for the encoder and 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for the head, 50 warmup updates, cosine decay, gradient clipping at 1.0 and bfloat16 arithmetic. Training takes about 91 minutes on six RTX A6000 GPUs.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: The convention adapter failed for a reason that supports Section 5 : two corpora transcribed into speaker attributed utterances still disagree about where an utterance ends. Matching a benchmark’s convention therefore needs references made the way the benchmark’s are, or a convention documented precisely enough to be reproduced.
blocks.zh: 公约适配器失败的原因是支持第5节:将两个corpora转写成扬声器, 因此,要与基准公约相匹配,就需要参照基准的方式,或准确地记录一份足以复制的公约。

blocks.en: Anuvani-Diarization’s Indian adaptation data covers eight languages of two party telephone conversation, yet ten of the fourteen languages in which it leads are languages it never saw in adaptation, including Manipuri, Sanskrit, Urdu and Santali. This suggests that the adaptation mostly teaches the acoustic and conversational conditions of Indian speech, which transfer across the families of the linguistic area, rather than properties of particular languages. Difficulty remains where conversation is hardest: near field debates with many participants and over 20% overlapped speech, as in Nepali, Telugu, Maithili and Dogri.
blocks.zh: Anuvani-Diarization的印度人适应数据涵盖两个政党电话交谈的八种语言,然而它所领导的十四种语言中有十种是它在适应中从未见过的语言,包括马尼普里语,梵语,乌尔都语和桑塔利语. 这表明改编大多教印度语的相声和对话条件,这些条件跨越了语言地区的家庭,而不是特定语言的属性. 在尼泊尔、泰卢固、迈蒂利和多格里等地,

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: We presented the first systematic study of dedicated speaker diarization systems across India’s 22 scheduled languages, showed that the benchmark’s utterance level convention is a hidden variable worth 1.9 to 4.1 pp of DER and that a convention learned from other transcriptions does not transfer to it, and introduced Anuvani-Diarization, which, evaluated zero shot, is the most accurate of all systems we ran (16.78% duration weighted DER) and matches its parent across six international benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了对印度22种排定语言的专用扬声器分级系统的首次系统研究,显示基准的分级协议是一个隐性变量,价值为1.9至4.1页,从其他抄录中吸取的公约不转录给它,并引入了Anuvani-分级协议,通过零镜头评估,它是我们运行的所有系统中最准确的(16.78%的加权分级协议),并且与它的母体系相匹配,跨越了六个国际基准。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Anuvani-Diarization does not model the benchmark’s segmentation convention: matching it would lower its DER by about 1.9 pp (Table 2 ), but our attempt to learn it from other transcriptions failed (§ 5.1 ), and we did not fit it on the benchmark itself. Its duration weighted DER remains 0.78 pp above the 16.0% self-reported by Sarvam AI, whose system we did not run. The segmentation network models at most four simultaneous speakers within a 16 s window, although the number of speakers per recording is unbounded. The Indian adaptation data comprises two party telephone calls in eight languages; multi-party Indian meetings for training would likely help further. Our evaluation uses one benchmark of 108 hours; the international results provide a second view but not an Indian one. The network inherits the non-commercial license (CC BY-NC 4.0) of its parent model’s weights.
blocks.zh: Anuvani-Diarization并不模拟基准的分块公约:与之相匹配将使其DER降低约1.9pp(表2),但我们试图从其他抄录中学习它的努力失败了(第5.1节),而且我们并不符合基准本身。 Sarvam AI自报的16.0%, 我们没有运行该系统。 在16s窗口内最多4名同时发言的分区网络模型,虽然每次录音的发言者人数没有限制。 印度的适应数据包括两个用八种语言的政党电话;多政党的印度培训会议可能会有帮助。 我们的评价使用一个108小时的基准;国际结果提供了第二种观点,但不是印度观点。 网络继承其母型号重量的非商业许可证(CC BY-NC 4.0).

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: All training and evaluation data are publicly released research corpora, used under their terms of release; no new recordings of people were made. Diarization identifies when different people speak but not who they are; it can nevertheless be combined with other tools to profile speakers, and the model’s weights are licensed for non-commercial research use only. Performance varies across languages and conditions (Table 1 ); deployments should evaluate on their own population.
blocks.zh: 所有培训和评价数据都是公开发布的研究公司,在其发布条款下使用;没有为人们录制新的录音. 数字化可以识别不同的人何时说话,但不能识别他们是谁;然而,它可以与其他工具相结合来描述演讲者的情况,模型的权重只被许可用于非商业研究。 各种语文和条件的表现各不相同(表1);部署情况应当对自己的人口进行评估。
